clue.text: Building again, but cutting corners perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the two words cutting corners might be arranged some other way

explanation.surface: Rebuilding work done on the cheap, with shortcuts taken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cutting corners' reads as the idiom for skimping, but its fourteen letters are the fodder, rearranged as 'perhaps' suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: Rebuilding something is putting it together once more, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Falls back on seaside places

explanation.surface: Someone retreats to the coast.
explanation.definitionFit: One falls back on last expedients, and holiday towns by the sea are the other sense.

clue.text: One who hits back at shop lifter perhaps

explanation.surface: Someone retaliates against a shoplifter.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is whimsical: a shoplifter goes for the shop counter, so is one who attacks the counter.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who retaliates strikes in return; a thief raiding the till assaults the shop's serving bench.

clue.text: Record a little music

explanation.surface: Write down a snatch of a tune.
explanation.definitionFit: To jot something down is to register it, and a single sounded pitch is a tiny piece of music.

clue.text: Fish about right for the channel

indicators.note: about means the fish's name goes round the letter for right

parts.note: the tench is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A fish swims round the right way for the canal.
explanation.definitionFit: A long narrow ditch dug in the ground is a channel.

clue.text: Only one way to do it

definitions.text: Only one way to do it

parts.words: Only one way to do it
parts.note: read literally, in a manner belonging to just one, without equal or alternative

explanation.surface: There is just one correct method.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done in a singular, one-of-a-kind manner is done in only one way.

clue.text: Ordered to steal train, that's a bit of a puzzle…

indicators.note: ordered says the letters of steal train are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is told to hijack a train, which is rather baffling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ordered' looks like a command given to someone, but it signals the anagram; 'to' and 'that's' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A teasing brainteaser that keeps the solution just out of reach is a mild puzzle.

clue.text: However, way might be found when sitting down

parts.words: way might be found when sitting down
parts.note: someone seated is not standing; the phrase splits into three words meaning just that

explanation.surface: A path may appear when one sits down.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as NOT WITH STANDING, the word describes someone sitting.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words introduce a contrast: nevertheless, all the same.

clue.text: Rate change on the railway main line

indicators.note: change tells us the letters of rate are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fare alteration on the main railway route.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Change' turns RATE into ARTE; 'main line' sounds like a railway but is a major blood vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A major blood vessel carrying blood from the heart is a main line, also used of a principal route.

clue.text: Sink the vessel carrying coal

explanation.surface: Someone sinks the coal ship.
explanation.definitionFit: To deliberately hole a ship is to send it down, and a household coal bucket is the other sense.

clue.text: I ring back about a note on someone who started a fire

indicators.note: about places the reversed ring around the note
back says the word ring is read in reverse

parts.note: TE is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Someone phones back about a note left by an arsonist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back' turns RING into GNIR, and 'about' puts TE inside it to give GNITER.
explanation.definitionFit: Something or someone that lights or kindles is one who set a blaze going.

clue.text: At, or about, on schedule

indicators.note: about indicates the letters of at and or are moved around

explanation.surface: Roughly on time.
explanation.definitionFit: A list of who does duty when is a schedule.

clue.text: The case for the prosecution?

parts.note: a grammatical case whose name suggests charging someone, the side that accuses in court

explanation.surface: The argument made against a defendant in court.
explanation.definitionFit: The grammatical case of the direct object has a name that suggests accusing someone, as prosecutors do.

clue.text: A prince called in about this young lady

definitions.text: A prince called in about this young lady

parts.words: A prince called in about this young lady
parts.note: the fairy tale where the prince calls at the house with a lost glass slipper

explanation.surface: A royal visitor came enquiring about a girl.
explanation.definitionFit: The fairy-tale heroine is sought by the prince who calls on her household with the glass slipper.

clue.text: Stretch the melody

explanation.surface: Extend the tune.
explanation.definitionFit: To pull taut is to stretch, and a strain is also a passage of music or tune.

clue.text: Lay about may be omnipotent being

indicators.note: about indicates the pieces are shuffled around

parts.note: might is the past tense of may

explanation.surface: An idler might turn out to be all-powerful.
explanation.walkthrough: LAY and MIGHT (past of 'may') are mixed by 'about': LAY scrambled as ALY round MIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: God, the all-powerful, is called the Almighty, a being with unlimited power.

clue.text: Disengage cockney wife about 50 in London district

indicators.note: about means the word for wife goes round the other letters

parts.note: my old Dutch is cockney slang for one's wife
EC is the East Central postal district of London
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A cockney wife in her fifties breaks away in a London area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'My old Dutch' is Cockney (East London) slang for a wife; 'in' is a link here.
explanation.definitionFit: To release a car's clutch pedal mechanism is to disengage the gears.

clue.text: Left accompanied by Miss Barrymore

parts.note: with means together with, accompanied by
Drew Barrymore is an American actress

explanation.surface: Drew Barrymore's companion departed.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave or retire from a place is to pull back from it.

clue.text: Power given to the French to hurdle

parts.note: the watt is the unit of power

explanation.surface: Energy granted to the French for jumping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hurdle' is a noun here: a wattle is a woven fence panel of twigs.
explanation.definitionFit: Interwoven sticks form a fencing panel, the old farm sense of a movable fence section.

clue.text: Dried up old bean fast approaching forty nine!

parts.note: Lent is the Christian period of fasting
IL is forty-nine in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A worn-out old chap is nearly forty-nine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old bean' looks like a jokey term for a man, but it is a dried pulse; 'approaching' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A small dried pulse seed used in soups is a kind of bean.

clue.text: Let Tory group arrange for national gambling

indicators.note: arrange tells us to rearrange the letters of let Tory into a group

explanation.surface: A Conservative faction sets up a state betting scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A state-run draw selling tickets for prizes is a form of nationwide betting.

clue.text: Girl who is out of breath

indicators.note: out of suggests the name is made from breath disordered

explanation.surface: A young woman who is panting.
explanation.definitionFit: Bertha is a woman's name.

clue.text: Item often used at 25

parts.note: 25 is the afternoon break for a cuppa; the item is the wheeled cart for serving it

explanation.surface: Something commonly used at a particular time of day.
explanation.definitionFit: A wheeled stand for carrying cups and cakes is used at the afternoon meal.

clue.text: One bit of kitchen furniture

explanation.surface: A single piece of kitchen fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: A single thing is the figure one, and a fitted kitchen cupboard is also so called.

clue.text: I ask for a monkey

indicators.note: for loosely signals the letters of I ask are rearranged to stand for the animal

explanation.surface: Someone requests a monkey.
explanation.definitionFit: The saki is a South American primate with a bushy tail.

clue.text: Leak out hindered pond

indicators.note: out indicates the word leak is jumbled

parts.note: let is an old word for hindered, still heard in tennis and in without let or hindrance

explanation.surface: A leaking pond is obstructed.
explanation.definitionFit: A small lake is a pool or pond.

clue.text: Eat item served on 21 now

indicators.note: served suggests the letters of eat item are dished up in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Food served from the tea trolley, as it is time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On 21' links to the tea trolley entry: food is served on it now, at the hour for tea.
explanation.definitionFit: The afternoon hour for the meal is announced as the present moment, it is that time now.

clue.text: Very surprisingly, a number brake tightly

indicators.note: surprisingly signals the letters of the following words are set out unexpectedly

explanation.surface: Unexpectedly, many people apply the brakes hard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Very' is the definition; 'surprisingly' shuffles A, N (number), BRAKE and TIGHTLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Astonishingly, stunningly or extremely — an intensifier like very.
